name: runway
description: Runway API: image/text/video to video, video upscale and text to image as polled tasks (paid per credit), task status and credits

nodes.title: Image to video
nodes.description: Animate an image into a video with a Runway model (paid; waits for the task and saves the video)

model.description: Runway model id, e.g. gen4.5 (12 credits/s), gen4_turbo (5 credits/s, image only), veo3.1, veo3.1_fast, kling3.0_pro, seedance2, hailuo3

prompt_image.description: First frame: an https URL, a runway:// upload URI or a data: URI (up to 5 MB)

prompt_text.description: What should happen in the video (required by gen4.5)

ratio.description: Output resolution as W:H, e.g. 1280:720 or 720:1280. Required by gen4.5, gen4_turbo and veo3.1; omit it for models that do not take it (e.g. h3_max)

duration.description: Seconds of video (gen4.5: 2–10, required; veo3.1: 4, 6 or 8; kling models up to 15)

audio.description: Generate audio (veo3.1, kling, seedance, hailuo models; affects price)

public_figure_threshold.description: low makes moderation less strict about recognizable public figures

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

model.description: Runway model id, e.g. gen4.5 (12 credits/s), gen4_turbo (5 credits/s, image only), veo3.1, veo3.1_fast, kling3.0_pro, seedance2, hailuo3

prompt_text.description: What should appear in the video

ratio.description: Output resolution as W:H, e.g. 1280:720 or 720:1280. Required by gen4.5, gen4_turbo and veo3.1; omit it for models that do not take it (e.g. h3_max)

duration.description: Seconds of video (gen4.5: 2–10, required; veo3.1: 4, 6 or 8; kling models up to 15)

audio.description: Generate audio (veo3.1, kling, seedance, hailuo models; affects price)

public_figure_threshold.description: low makes moderation less strict about recognizable public figures

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

nodes.title: Video to video
nodes.description: Edit or restyle an input video (up to 30 s) with a prompt, e.g. with aleph2 (paid; waits and saves the video); give video_uri or prompt_video as the model expects

model.description: Runway model id, e.g. aleph2 (28 credits/s, 56 minimum)

video_uri.description: Input video for aleph2, gemini_omni_flash* and kling_4*: an https URL, a runway:// upload URI or a data: URI

prompt_video.description: Input video for seedance2*, hailuo3* and klingO3* models (instead of video_uri)

prompt_text.description: What the edited video should show

nodes.title: Text to image
nodes.description: Generate an image from a prompt and optional reference images (paid; waits and saves the image)

model.description: Runway image model, e.g. gen4_image (5–8 credits), gen4_image_turbo (2 credits, needs reference_images)

prompt_text.description: What the image should show; reference tags as @tag

ratio.description: Output resolution as W:H, e.g. 1920:1080 or 1024:1024 (required by most image models; optional for ideogram and vector models)

public_figure_threshold.description: low makes moderation less strict about recognizable public figures
